# testdata/rack_smoke

Synthetic phone photos of shingled columns, generated by `tools/synthgen` (tools/synthgen v1).
Only `manifest.json` is committed; the JPEGs contain Wizards of the Coast card art
(images from Scryfall) and are regenerated locally:

```
uv run --project tools tools/synthgen/gen.py --set rack_smoke --regen
```

That downloads the card images once into `testdata/cache/` (gitignored) and
rebuilds every image bit-for-bit from the per-image seeds in the manifest (same
machine and pinned library versions). The set was created with
`gen.py --set rack_smoke --n 16 --seed 4 --mode rack` (card pool v2).
Rack mode: cards stand in the tilted-slot racks of SPEC section 1b / fab/ (3D-rendered, name text up to ~3.6 mm below the marker plane).

Contents: 16 images (10 C4, 6 C6;
4 easy, 4 hard, 8 normal), 1475 true card slots
(en 1039 (70%), other 60 (4%), pt 376 (25%));
1314 distinct printings, 1260 distinct oracle_ids.
2 images with stop cards (partial columns), 1 retake images (a marker
hidden), 1 images with a 19-card column without stop card (column must be `error`).

Score a reader with:

```
uv run --project tools tools/eval.py --manifest testdata/rack_smoke/manifest.json --results <dir>
```

See `manifest.json` -> `eval_notes` for how `lang: other`, tags and negative cases are scored.
